title: app/ — React SPA + local egress bridge replacing the Python server
summary: app/ — React 18 + TypeScript + Vite single-page chat UI over 50 models from 6 providers, replacing the Python/FastAPI server (left byte-identical). TRANSPORT IS DIRECT: the browser builds each request and POSTs it straight to the provider's real endpoint, so the URL in the DevTools network log is the URL the code called. No relay in the request path, no Python. A Node relay is retained only as an opt-in per-provider fallback. Five wire formats normalise to one StreamEvent union so the UI never branches on provider. DevsDo removed; Upstage is v3. 82/82 tests, tsc strict exit 0, vite build 211.54 kB JS / 64.41 kB gzip.

facts.claim: Revision 2 added src/lib/{stream,direct,payloads,headers,mock}.ts and flipped all seven providers to transport:'direct'. stream.ts is the single entry point routing mock/direct/bridge. mock.ts generates SSE in-browser so the Offline Simulator needs zero network and zero relay - a test asserts fetch is never called while it runs. App.tsx gained a Keys credential panel (Upstage CSRF, Mercury session token, localStorage only).

32 files tracked under app/ (node_modules and dist correctly excluded by the new root .gitignore). Roughly 4,512 hand-written lines of TS/TSX/MJS/Python/CSS plus 689 generated lines in src/data/models.ts.

Stack: Vite 5 + React 18.3 + TypeScript 5.6, tsx for tests, @types/node. Production bundle 192.47 kB JS (58.82 kB gzip) and 13.11 kB CSS (3.48 kB gzip), 42 modules, built in 1.26s. No UI framework, no state library, no markdown library.
Bridge has ZERO runtime dependencies - only node:http plus local modules. Requires Node >=20 for global fetch and ReadableStream. Binds 127.0.0.1:8787 by default.
evidence: package.json dependencies contain only react and react-dom

facts.claim: Model data is GENERATED, never hand-typed. scripts/dump_registry.py executes the real Models.py (stdlib-only so it runs with no dependencies installed) and emits src/data/models.ts. Output: 64 registry models -> 32 after dropping DevsDo-exclusive entries, plus 18 recovered DeepInfra models = 50 across 6 providers. LLMChat @cf/@hf tags joined 24/24. Upstage ids asserted against v3 _MODELS 4/4.

Tests: 60 total, 60 pass, 0 fail in about 4.7s via node --test with tsx. Split as 47 unit tests over the four wire formats, the SSE framer and ThinkSplitter; 3 differential tests covering 815 cases generated by executing the original Python ThinkSplitter; 10 integration tests that spawn the real bridge on port 8799 and drive it through the real browser-side modules.
npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 with no output under strict mode plus noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noImplicitOverride and verbatimModuleSyntax.

Live pipeline verified against the running bridge THROUGH the Vite proxy (the exact path a browser uses): GET /bridge/health -> 200 with all 6 providers plus mock, DevsDo absent, credentials {Upstage:false, Mercury:false}. GET / -> 200. POST mock -> event:meta then event:raw frames streaming. POST Upstage -> meta then error{code:missing_credentials} then end. POST DevsDo -> 404. POST malformed JSON -> 400.

Architecture: four provider wire formats (openai-delta, workers-raw, reasoning-delta, typed-events) plus upstage-v3 normalise to a single StreamEvent union (thinking|content|source|usage|status|done|error). The UI renders only StreamEvent and never branches on provider, so a fifth format needs one normaliser and zero UI changes.

NOT DONE and not claimed: no live call against any real provider (sandbox TLS egress blocked, curl exit 35 for all six hosts); no real-DOM browser E2E (no browser, no docker); Upstage/Mercury credential capture not ported; Dolphin attachment UI not wired; no security review (deferred by user instruction).
The Python server is untouched. git diff on 'My PREVIOUS ENTIRE SERVER/' and 'New Upstage Change Logs/' is empty; all changes are new paths under app/, .aduskills/, .gitignore and AGENTS.md.
